arxiv-2103-07449.title: Cooperative Self-training of Machine Reading Comprehension
arxiv-2103-07449.creator: Hongyin Luo Shang-Wen Li Mingye Gao Seunghak Yu James Glass
arxiv-2103-07449.description: Abstract Pretrained language models have significantly improved the performance of downstream language understanding tasks, including extractive question answering, by providing high-quality contextualized word embeddings. However, training question answering models still requires large amounts of annotated data for specific domains. In this work, we propose a cooperative self-training framework, RGX, for automatically generating more non-trivial question-answer pairs to improve model performance.

arxiv-2107-01014.title: Breakdown of the Hund’s Rule in CuFeAs
arxiv-2107-01014.creator: Ze-Yi Song, Xiu-Cai Jiang, Xiao-Fang Ouyang, Yu-Zhong Zhang
arxiv-2107-01014.description: Abstract The ground-state properties of CuFeAs were investigated by applying density functional theory calculations within generalized gradient approximation (GGA) and GGA+U. We find that the bicollinear antiferromagnetic state with antiparallel orbital magnetic moments on each iron which violates the Hund’s rule is favored by the on-site Coulomb interaction, which is further stabilized by Cu vacancy.

arxiv-2109-07630.title: Reinforcement Learning Policies in Continuous-Time Linear Systems
arxiv-2109-07630.creator: Mohamad Kazem Shirani Faradonbeh, Mohamad Sadegh Shirani Faradonbeh
arxiv-2109-07630.description: Abstract Linear dynamical systems that obey stochastic differential equations are canonical models. While optimal control of known systems has a rich literature, the problem is technically hard under model uncertainty and there are hardly any results. We initiate study of this problem and aim to learn (and simultaneously deploy) optimal actions for minimizing a quadratic cost function.

arxiv-2303-15376.title: Identifiability of causal graphs under non-additive conditionally parametric causal models
arxiv-2303-15376.creator: Juraj Bodik juraj.bodik@unil.ch, Valérie Chavez-Demoulin valerie.chavez@unil.ch
arxiv-2303-15376.description: Abstract Existing approaches to causal discovery often rely on restrictive modeling assumptions that limit their applicability in real-world settings, particularly when data are heavy-tailed or contain a mixture of discrete and continuous variables. Identifiability of causal graphs has been established under several structural models, including linear non-Gaussian models, post-nonlinear models, and location-scale models.

arxiv-2310-01856.title: Nonlocal Contributions to the Turbulent Cascade in Magnetohydrodynamic Plasmas
arxiv-2310-01856.creator: J. Friedrich, M. Wilbert, R. Marino
arxiv-2310-01856.description: Abstract We present evidence for nonlocal contributions to the turbulent energy cascade in magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) plasmas. Therefore, we revisit a well-known result derived directly from the MHD equations, i.e., the Politano & Pouquet (P&P) law for the transfer of kinetic and magnetic energy in scale.

arxiv-2402-13549.title: Q-learning-based Joint Design of Adaptive Modulation and Precoding for Physical Layer Security in Visible Light Communications
arxiv-2402-13549.creator: Duc M. T. Hoang 1 , Thanh V. Pham 3 , Anh T. Pham 4 , and Chuyen T. Nguyen 1
arxiv-2402-13549.description: Abstract Physical layer security (PLS) offers a unique approach to protecting information confidentiality against eavesdropping by malicious users. This paper studies a joint design of adaptive M − M- ary pulse amplitude modulation (PAM) and precoding for performance improvement of PLS in visible light communications (VLC).

arxiv-2402-18470.title: A Higher-Order Lens for Social Systems
arxiv-2402-18470.creator: Giulia Preti, Adriano Fazzone, Giovanni Petri, Gianmarco De Francisci Morales
arxiv-2402-18470.description: Abstract Despite the widespread adoption of higher-order mathematical structures such as hypergraphs, methodological tools for their analysis lag behind those for traditional graphs. This work addresses a critical gap in this context by proposing two micro-canonical random null models for directed hypergraphs: the Directed Hypergraph Configuration Model ( DHCM ) and the Directed Hypergraph JOINT Model ( DHJM ).

arxiv-2403-13571.title: Graphs of large girth
arxiv-2403-13571.creator: Christian Reiher
arxiv-2403-13571.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Christian Reiher. This survey on graphs of large girth consists of two parts. The first deals with some aspects of algebraic and extremal graph theory loosely related to the Moore bound. Our point of departure for the second, Ramsey theoretic, part are some constructions of graphs with large chromatic number and large girth; this will lead us to a discussion of the recent girth Ramsey theorem. Both parts can be enjoyed independently of each other.

arxiv-2407-12965.title: Little Red Dots from Low-Spin Galaxies at High Redshifts
arxiv-2407-12965.creator: Abraham Loeb
arxiv-2407-12965.description: Abstract Recently, a new population of compact, high-redshift ( z ≳ 7 z\gtrsim 7 ) galaxies appeared as little red dots (LRDs) in deep JWST observations. The latest spectroscopic data indicates that these galaxies contain an evolved stellar population, reflecting an early episode of high star-formation-rate.

arxiv-2410-22034.description: Abstract . We show that if E E is a countable Borel equivalence relation on ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} , then there is a closed subset A ⊆ [ 0 , 1 ] n A\subseteq[0,1]^{n} of Hausdorff dimension n n so that E ↾ A E\restriction A is smooth.

arxiv-2509-19970.title: Control and Navigation of a 2-D Electric Rocket
arxiv-2509-19970.creator: André Fonte, Pedro dos Santos, Paulo Oliveira
arxiv-2509-19970.description: Abstract This work addresses the control and navigation of a simulated two-dimensional electric rocket. The model provides a simplified framework that neglects actuator dynamics and aerodynamic effects while capturing the complexities of underactuation and state coupling. Trajectory tracking is achieved through a modularized and layered control architecture, with employement of a Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) and Lyapunov theory.

arxiv-2512-02008.title: The Art of Scaling Test-Time Compute for Large Language Models
arxiv-2512-02008.creator: Aradhye Agarwal Ayan Sengupta Tanmoy Chakraborty
arxiv-2512-02008.description: Abstract Test-time scaling (TTS)—the dynamic allocation of compute during inference—is a promising direction for improving reasoning in large language models (LLMs). However, a systematic comparison of well-known TTS strategies under identical conditions is missing, and the influence of model type and problem difficulty on performance remains unclear.

arxiv-2602-03366.title: Entanglement Islands, Page curves and Phase Transitions of Kerr-AdS Black Holes
arxiv-2602-03366.creator: Digen Das 1,2, Mozib Bin Awal 1, Prabwal Phukon 1,3
arxiv-2602-03366.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Digen Das 1,2, Mozib Bin Awal 1, Prabwal Phukon 1,3. We study the Page curve and information paradox for Kerr AdS black hole in light of entanglement entropy by employing the recently proposed island paradigm. By incorporating the island rule, we show that the entanglement entropy of Kerr AdS black hole grows linearly at early times and declines to a constant value at late times in agreement with the well established Page curve.

pmc-10595708.creator: R M Savela, I Nykänen, S Koponen, A L Suominen, U Schwab, T Välimäki
pmc-10595708.description: BackgroundFamily caregivers may experience financial vulnerabilities due to their caregiving role, affecting their ability to afford appropriate food and ensure optimal nutrient intake. Therefore, this cross-sectional study aimed to assess the extent to which there are diet-related disparities among older family caregivers.MethodsWe included 125 family caregivers from Eastern Finland (mean age 74 y).

pmc-11369094.title: Analysis of the impact of digital literacy on life satisfaction (2019–2022) for older adults in South Korea: a national community-based panel study
pmc-11369094.creator: Hocheol Lee
pmc-11369094.description: This study analyzed the effects of digital literacy on life satisfaction in older adults aged 65 years and above in modern day Korea. It utilized raw data from the 2019–2022 Report on the Digital Divide, an annual survey conducted by the Korean Ministry of Science and Information and Communications Technology. A total of 4,216 participants were assessed from 2019–2022.

pmc-11438062.title: Association of changes and cumulative measures of triglyceride-glucose index-body mass index with hypertension risk: a prospective cohort study
pmc-11438062.creator: Jiamin Yan, Min-zhe Zhang, Qi-qiang He
pmc-11438062.description: BackgroundTo investigate the relationships of the dynamic changes in triglyceride glucose index-body mass index (TyG‑BMI) and cumulative TyG-BMI with the risk of hypertension among middle-aged and elderly Chinese.MethodsData were used from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS). Participants who participated in the baseline study (2011–2012) and in subsequent surveys (2015–2018) were included in this study.

pmc-11476936.title: A Review of Evidence Related to the Zoonotic Characteristics of the Monkeypox Virus
pmc-11476936.creator: Kawsari Abdullah, Junayd Hussain, Emilie Chan, Kylie Tingley, Valentina Ly, J Scott Weese, Nicole Shaver, Alexandria Bennett, Melissa Brouwers
pmc-11476936.description: The 2022 monkeypox virus (MPXV) outbreaks spurred global public health concern. In response, we undertook a living systematic review of its zoonotic characteristics, including potential reservoirs and susceptible species, transmissibility, and clinical presentation in nonhuman species. Electronic database searches yielded 148 eligible records published between 2000 and 2022.

pmc-11495496.title: Non-innocent P-centers in nonbenzenoid polycyclic aromatic molecules with tunable structures and properties†
pmc-11495496.creator: Can Li, Wei Zhou, Zhaoxin Liu, Rong Gao, Qixi Mi, Zhijun Ning, Yi Ren
pmc-11495496.description: Implanting heteroatoms into polycyclic aromatic molecules (PAMs) offers a great opportunity to fine-tune their optoelectronic properties. Herein, we report a new type of nonbenzenoid PAM in which the sp2 C atoms are replaced by S and P in the azulene moiety.

pmc-12950811.title: Engineering the nursing profession: China’s academician system reform and its implications for interdisciplinary health workforce development
pmc-12950811.creator: Wan-Qiong Zhou, Cheng-Rui Zhang, Ying Xing, Wei Luan
pmc-12950811.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In 2025, the Chinese Academy of Engineering’s inclusion of “Nursing” as an independent academician-track discipline marks a historic milestone. While affirming nursing’s disciplinary value and strategic importance to the “Healthy China” initiative, this reform presents a “preparedness crisis.” To succeed, nursing must pivot from soft service models to hard technological innovation, leveraging medical-industrial integration and interdisciplinary talent to meet rigorous engineering criteria.Subject terms: Health occupations, Engineering In June 2025, the Chinese Academy of Engineering officially released the Implementation Measures for the Election

pmc-13272345.title: DESI-MSI applications for direct (spatial) biomolecular analysis of South African natural medicinal products
pmc-13272345.creator: Kabelo N. Mohlamonyane, Efficient N. Ncube, Marco Giampà, Weiyang Chen, Dylan Zeiss, Peter D. Verhaert, Bart Ghesquière, Alvaro M. Viljoen
pmc-13272345.description: IntroductionIn pharmacognosy, conventional analytical methods provide important chemical information on metabolite identities and relative quantities. However, in situ analysis and the mapping of the spatial distribution of metabolites remain underexplored. Mass spectrometry (MS) imaging techniques, specifically desorption electrospray ionization-MS imaging (DESI-MSI), enables the in situ analysis and visualization of the spatial distribution of metabolites in different plant tissues.

pmc-13372117.title: Protecting honey bees (Apis mellifera) from thermal stress: Probiotics and prebiotics buffer the survival and antioxidant enzyme activity
pmc-13372117.creator: Rahil Mirabi Moghaddam, Najmeh Sahebzadeh, Ehsan Rakhshani, Naser Tajabadi, Rassol Bahreini, Vicente Martínez López, Vicente Martínez López, Vicente Martínez López
pmc-13372117.description: Environmental temperature profoundly influences honey bee (Apis mellifera) physiology, behavior, and survival. In recent years, nutritional interventions have gained attention as potential strategies to mitigate stress-induced physiological disruptions in honey bees. This study evaluated the efficacy of dietary supplementations enriched with combined prebiotics and probiotics in alleviating temperature-related stress.

pmc-13429387.title: Organic and inorganic selenium-enriched Lactobacillus plantarum differentially enhance bacterial antioxidant capacity and support redox homeostasis in intestinal Caco-2 cells through probiotic and postbiotic effects
pmc-13429387.creator: Adriana García-Vara, Marta Titos-Zamora, Ruth Ferrer, Raquel Martín-Venegas
pmc-13429387.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Selenium (Se)-enriched probiotics represent a valuable strategy for delivering this essential trace element in both human and animal nutrition. This study evaluated the effects of organic and inorganic Se supplementation at low (5 μM) and high (250 μM) concentrations on the bacterial antioxidant capacity of Lactobacillus plantarum (LP), as well as the ability of the resulting probiotics and postbiotics (non-lysed cell-free supernatants, CFS) to modulate redox homeostasis in intestinal Caco-2 cells.

pmc-13616471.title: Design, Synthesis, and Biological Evaluation of Pyrazol‐5‐yl‐Phenylacetamide Derivatives as Potential Fungicidal Agents
pmc-13616471.creator: Guo‐Tai Lin, Wei Wang, Xi‐Zhe Zhang, Li Luo, Gong Xu, Dan Xu
pmc-13616471.description: Fungal infestation in crops can greatly reduce both yield and quality. To discover new fungicides, pyrazol‐5‐yl‐phenylacetamide derivatives were synthesized by elongating the carbon chain of the lead compound pyrazol‐5‐yl‐benzamides. These derivatives were assessed for their effectiveness against fungi. Compound C‐13 displayed significant antifungal activity against Sclerotinia sclerotiorum, with an EC50 value of 2.51 mg/L.

pmc-13652466.title: Retroperitoneal necrotizing fasciitis masquerading as perforated viscus: a rare case report
pmc-13652466.creator: Binyam Mulatu Habte, Yoseph Mulatu Habte, Abel Tariku Agoje, Makida Mulatu Habte, Helina Takele, Dagmawi Dagne Gelaye
pmc-13652466.description: Introduction and importance:Necrotizing fasciitis is a rapidly progressive, life-threatening soft-tissue infection associated with high mortality, particularly when diagnosis is delayed. While most cases involve the extremities or perineum, retroperitoneal necrotizing fasciitis is exceedingly rare. Its deep anatomical location often results in vague clinical presentations, allowing extensive infection before overt signs develop, which poses significant diagnostic and therapeutic challenges.
